intro.heading: d-Block Elements: Definition & Position
intro.p1: Elements in whose atoms the last electron enters into the d-orbital are called d-block elements.
intro.p2: In these elements, the (n-1)d subshell is partially filled or the incoming electron enters the (n-1)d subshell.
intro.p3: In these elements, the number of electrons in the outermost shell (n) remains similar, hence similarity is observed in their properties.
intro.p4: d-block elements are also termed transition elements. Total number of d-block elements in the periodic table is 40. Transition elements are divided into four transition series.

series1.heading: (a) First Transition Series (3d Series)
series1.p1: This series is also known as the 3d transition series.
series1.p2: This series contains 10 elements (Atomic numbers 21 to 30).
series1.elements: Sc₂₁, Ti₂₂, V₂₃, Cr₂₄, Mn₂₅, Fe₂₆, Co₂₇, Ni₂₈, Cu₂₉, Zn₃₀
series1.p3: These have an incomplete 3d subshell, while the 4s orbital contains one or two electrons.
series1.p4: General electronic configuration of this series is 3d¹⁻¹⁰ 4s¹⁻².

series2.heading: (b) Second Transition Series (4d Series)
series2.p1: This series is also known as the 4d transition series.
series2.p2: This series contains 10 elements (Atomic numbers 39 to 48).
series2.elements: Y₃₉, Zr₄₀, Nb₄₁, Mo₄₂, Tc₄₃, Ru₄₄, Rh₄₅, Pd₄₆, Ag₄₇, Cd₄₈
series2.p3: These have an incomplete 4d subshell, while 5s has one, two or zero electrons.
series2.p4: Electronic configuration of this series is 4d¹⁻¹⁰ 5s⁰⁻².

series3.heading: (c) Third Transition Series (5d Series)
series3.p1: This is also called the 5d transition series.
series3.p2: It contains 10 elements (Atomic number 57, then 72 to 80).
series3.elements: La₅₇, Hf₇₂, Ta₇₃, W₇₄, Re₇₅, Os₇₆, Ir₇₇, Pt₇₈, Au₇₉, Hg₈₀
series3.p3: It has an incomplete 5d subshell while the 6s orbital contains one or two electrons.

series4.heading: (d) Fourth Transition Series (6d Series)
series4.p1: This is also called the 6d transition series.
series4.p2: This series has 10 elements, making it complete as well (Atomic numbers 89, 104 to 112).
series4.elements: Ac₈₉, Rf₁₀₄, Db₁₀₅, Sg₁₀₆, Bh₁₀₇, Hs₁₀₈, Mt₁₀₉, Ds₁₁₀, Rg₁₁₁, Uub₁₁₂ (Cn₁₁₂)
series4.transactinide: Elements from atomic number 104 to 112 are also called transactinide elements.
series4.p3: These contain an incomplete 6d subshell while the 7s orbital contains one or two electrons.
